svg.title: Планка с упором на фитбол — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One full-body three-quarter side view of a static stability-ball plank. Both forearms including elbows rest securely on TOP of one large clearly round Swiss ball, feet behind, only both toes contact floor. The athlete forms one straight line from shoulders through hips to ankles with neck neutral. No feet on the ball, no elbows on floor, no lifting arms. A thin short floor line can establish foot and ball contact. No second phase or extra figure. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
